You can run an instant webpage audit using the [EqualWeb Accessibility Checker](https://www.equalweb.com/platform/accessibility_checker/) to evaluate your site against WCAG 2.2 standards.[[1]](https://www.equalweb.com/platform/accessibility_checker/)

### Popular Accessibility Checkers

- **WAVE:** Try the [WAVE Evaluation Tool](https://wave.webaim.org/) by WebAIM to see visual feedback injected directly into your web pages via browser extensions.
- **accessScan:** Use [accessScan by accessiBe](https://accessibe.com/accessscan) for an AI-powered compliance audit that grades your page against 11 core WCAG criteria.
- **AccessibilityChecker.org:** Visit [AccessibilityChecker.org](https://www.accessibilitychecker.org/) for free compliance scans and guidance on international legislation like ADA and Section 508.[[1]](https://www.accessibilitychecker.org/)[[2]](https://wave.webaim.org/)[[3]](https://accessibe.com/accessscan)

### What Checkers Test For

- **Missing Alt Text:** Identifies images lacking text descriptions for screen readers.
- **Color Contrast:** Flags foreground and background color combinations that fail minimum readability ratios.
- **Form Labels:** Checks whether inputs and buttons have clear, programmatic labels.
- **Keyboard Navigation:** Highlights focus order and logical tab sequences.[[1]](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/office-accessibility/rules-for-the-accessibility-checker)[[2]](https://www.audioeye.com/website-accessibility-checker/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40x_i86f4zo)[[4]](https://silktide.com/toolbar/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lIq89uPcyd4)

> **Note:** Automated tools typically catch only 30% to 50% of accessibility errors. Complete compliance requires manual testing with keyboards and screen readers.[[1]](https://achecks.org/achecker)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40x_i86f4zo)

- Are you checking a **public website** or an **internal document** (like Word or PDF)?
- Do you need help with a **specific compliance standard** (ADA, Section 508, WCAG)?

I can recommend the best tool for your project.
